lines.text: - Why me? -Because you always mess it up.

lines.text: Okay, guys. Team Dunphy on three.

lines.text: Honey, what are you doing home

lines.text: -so early? -
lines.ko: 여보, 왜 이렇게 빨리 왔어?

lines.text: I quit. That man is a complete pig.

lines.text: He treated me like a servant
lines.ko: 그만뒀어 그 자식 완전 재수 없어 날 종처럼 부리잖아 존중이라곤 눈곱만큼도 없어

lines.text: and showed me absolutely no respect.

lines.text: I'm so sorry. You deserve better than that.

lines.text: I heard you!
